info.title: API: Experiences
info.description:
The Experiences API lets you search tours and activities, check availability, reviews, and booking options. Access must be enabled on your account.

## Errors

Errors use `{"error":{"code":72001,"message":"selection price mismatch"}}`. `error.code` is a Dispatcher-owned integer, not a provider code or an HTTP status. `message` is safe human-readable context; branch on the numeric code, not message text. Optional `description` is a string or structured validation details; optional `key` identifies a request field.

| Operation | Product error block |
| --- | --- |
| Search, tour details, reviews, availability, booking-options | 710xx |
| Prebook | 720xx |
| Confirm booking | 730xx |
| Get booking | 740xx |
| Cancellation preview | 750xx |
| Cancel booking | 751xx |

Each endpoint lists its codes below. `...99` is its generic fallback, not a retry instruction. Shared authentication, access and rate-limit middleware retain common codes such as `401`, `40301`, `4290` and `4291`; not every error on an Experiences URL starts with `7`. HTTP status and error code are separate: prebook validation may also arrive with HTTP 409 or 422.

### Price changes

Price mismatch uses numeric `72001`; its optional price-detail code, when present, is string `"72001"`. `requested` is the submitted customer SELL total and `expected` is the new customer SELL total in `currency`. For example, a submitted EUR 120 may become EUR 132. These totals already include pricing adjustments; do not apply markup or FX again. Details can have different codes for different causes, and preserve field identifiers and nullable participant indexes.

A timeout or 5xx response alone does not prove whether a mutating request was applied. Do not automatically repeat prebook, booking or cancellation solely because of that error.

tags.description: Checkout flow: **1.** Create an experience checkout session (PREBOOK) → **2.** Confirm an experience booking. Also includes retrieving booking status, previewing a cancellation, and cancelling a booking.

language.name: language
language.description: ISO language code for localized content

label.description: Human-readable option text shown in a dropdown or radio group.

value.description: Machine value submitted as the booking question answer when this option is selected.

id.description: UI-only pickup area identity; not a provider ID and not submitted with booking answers.

coordinates.description: Representative map coordinates for the area, not a booking answer.

id.description: UI-only canonical pickup choice identity; not a provider ID and not submitted with booking answers.

BookingPickupPresentationResponse.description: Provider-neutral pickup UI metadata. Booking answers remain address/latitude/longitude and never submit area/choice IDs.

mode.description: area = pick a real point inside allowed area bounds; location = select an exact predefined pickup point; map = free map/address search fallback.

areas.description: Allowed pickup regions for mode=area. Not selectable answers.

choices.description: Exact predefined pickup points for mode=location.

fields.description: Required and non-empty when type is group or pickup_location.

pickup.description: Pickup presentation metadata. Present only when type is pickup_location.

language.description: Languages this option is conducted/supported in.

services.description: Provider-sourced service flags; exact upstream semantics aren't formally published. Based on the `flags` filter values used elsewhere, `prt`/`stl`/`wlc` likely correspond to private/skip-the-line/wheelchair-accessible respectively — treat as indicative, not guaranteed.

coordinatePrecision.description: Precision/confidence of `coordinates`, when the provider supplies it.

nextAvailableDate.description: Next date/time this option can be booked, when the tour has no availability on the requested date.

slots.description: Priced time slots for this option. Use pricing.totals.net for checkout.

price.description: The price for the requested mix, based on the lowest available slot. Prefer the chosen slot's `pricing.totals.net` for `selection.price.amount` on prebook.

amount.description: Lowest available price for this option and participant mix.

prebookId.description: LiteAPI prebook session that created this booking.

cartId.description: Shopping cart identifier from the provider checkout session.

experienceBookingId.description: Internal booking identifier from the provider checkout session.

providerBookingReference.description: Booking reference, when available. Retained after cancellation.

price.description: Price charged via Stripe and persisted on the booking.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this booking.

voucherCode.description: Discount voucher code applied to this booking, if any.

voucherTotalAmount.description: Amount covered by the discount voucher. Zero when no voucher was applied.

cancellationRequestedAt.description: When cancellation was requested on this booking, if any.

cancelledAt.description: When this booking was fully cancelled, if applicable.

refundProcessedAt.description: When the refund for this booking's cancellation was processed, if applicable.

refund.description: Refund details, present once a cancellation has been processed.

customTags.description: Optional bag of up to 5 user-defined key/value labels persisted with the booking. Keys must match `^[A-Z0-9_-]+$`; values are strings up to 255 characters.

voucher.description: Provider voucher payload available after the booking is confirmed. Structure varies by provider; known fields for the current provider are listed below, but treat this object as provider-dependent.

supplierEmergencyPhoneNumber.description: Supplier's emergency contact phone number. Not the traveler's phone number.

supplierEmergencyEmail.description: Supplier's emergency contact email. This is not, and must never be treated as, the traveler's/customer's email address.

supplierBookingCodes.description: One entry per ticket, when the provider issues per-ticket codes.

experienceSnapshot.description: Versioned, provider-neutral snapshot of the tour/booking as it looked at booking time, for rendering post-booking pages (confirmation, manage-booking) without re-fetching the tour. `version: 2` is the active schema below. Deprecated `version: 1` top-level fields (`title`, `rating`, `media`, `startingLocation`, `schedule`, `guide`, `payment`, `cancellationPolicy`) may still appear on bookings made before the V2 migration — read them for old data, don't rely on them for new integrations.

isPartial.description: True if this snapshot is missing data (e.g. captured before all tour content was available).

pickup.description: Present when the guest selected a pickup location during checkout.

supplierEmergencyContact.description: Supplier's emergency contact for this booking. Not the traveler's/customer's contact details.

amount.description: The price shown on booking-options (`slots[].pricing.totals.net`, equivalent to `priceSummary.netPrice`).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the slot price.

numberOfParticipants.description: Count of participants in this category.

dateTime.description: Chosen slot start time from booking-options (`slots[].dateTime`).

value.description: Answer value. Type depends on the question: string for text/select, integer for date components, object for grouped fields like pickup_location.

field.description: Canonical field path. Either field or fieldId, or both, may be present.

fieldId.description: Canonical field identifier; an alias of field when both are present.

participantIndex.description: Zero-based participant index when relevant. An explicit null is preserved.

code.description: Optional Dispatcher detail code encoded as a string, for example "72001". Binding details may omit it; mixed causes can use different detail codes.

reason.description: Human-readable validation reason; do not parse it to identify the error.

requested.description: For price mismatch 72001, the submitted customer SELL total, not NET.

expected.description: For price mismatch 72001, the new customer SELL total. Pricing adjustments have already been applied.

currency.description: Currency of the price-mismatch SELL totals.

CanonicalBookingValidationError.description: Structured validation context. Field aliases, participant metadata and detail codes are preserved; a detail code is optional and need not equal the root code when several causes are present.

language.description: ISO language code used for validate and downstream book cart.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for validate and downstream book cart.

clientReferenceId.description: Partner reference echoed in prebook response and stored on the checkout session.

usePaymentSdk.description: Phase 1 requires `true` to create a Stripe PaymentIntent.

voucherCode.description: Optional discount voucher code. When valid the voucher amount is deducted from the Stripe PaymentIntent and charged separately to the agency's stored card at book time.

payment.description: Optional Stripe metadata (e.g. statement descriptor suffix).

prebookId.description: LiteAPI checkout session id. Pass to `POST /experiences/bookings`.

tourId.description: Provider tour id (from the path parameter).

optionId.description: Chosen tour option from the prebook selection.

dateTime.description: Chosen slot start time from the prebook selection.

clientReferenceId.description: Partner reference when provided on prebook.

participants.description: Participant mix from the prebook selection.

price.description: The price used to create the Stripe PaymentIntent for this checkout.

cartId.description: Shopping cart id from the provider checkout session.

experienceBookingId.description: Internal booking identifier from the provider checkout session.

providerBookingId.description: Provider booking hash from validate (`bookingId` upstream).

status.description: Validate hold status from the provider (typically `temp`).

transactionId.description: Stripe PaymentIntent transaction id. Confirm with Stripe SDK, then pass to book.

secretKey.description: Stripe client secret for PaymentIntent confirmation.

publishableKey.description: Stripe publishable key when returned by payment-gateway.

voucherCode.description: Echoed voucher code when a valid voucher was applied.

voucherTotalAmount.description: Amount covered by the voucher. Zero when no voucher was applied.

sellingPriceToUser.description: Amount the end-user actually pays (price minus voucher). Equals `price` when no voucher is applied.

reservationExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the validate hold (~10 minutes). Create a new prebook after expiry.

paymentTypes.description: Supported payment methods for book. Phase 1: `TRANSACTION_ID` only.

method.description: Phase 1 supports Stripe capture via `TRANSACTION_ID` only.

transactionId.description: Stripe transaction id from prebook. Omit to use the id stored on the prebook session.

customTags.description: Optional bag of up to 5 user-defined key/value labels persisted with the booking. Keys must match `^[A-Z0-9_-]+$`; values are strings up to 255 characters.

code.description: Dispatcher-owned numeric error code. Product-operation errors use 710xx, 720xx, 730xx, 740xx, 750xx or 751xx as listed on the endpoint. Shared middleware can return other numeric codes. This is not an HTTP status.

message.description: Safe human-readable error message. Use code, not message text, for programmatic handling.

description.description: Optional safe context: a string or structured validation details. Price mismatch 72001 carries customer SELL totals when valid; malformed monetary data is replaced by a generic error without price details.

key.description: Optional dot-path to the offending request field, such as bodyRequest.selection.price.amount, query.language or path.id.

minAge.description: Minimum age for this ticket category, from availability.

maxAge.description: Maximum age for this ticket category, from availability.

independentlyBookable.description: Whether this ticket category can be booked on its own without a required adult, from availability.

unitNet.description: Price per unit. unitNet × quantity may differ from totalNet by a cent due to rounding.

totalNet.description: Price for this line. Sum of totalNet reconciles to totals.net.
Price for the group ticket line.

net.description: The slot's total price. Use as selection.price.amount on prebook.

commission.description: Your earnings on this slot, when applicable.

netPrice.description: The slot's total price (same value as totals.net).

ExperienceSlotPricing.description: All slot pricing fields reflect your price for this booking.

unavailabilityReason.description: Why the slot is unavailable when isAvailable is false. Official provider groups: no_availability, not_enough_spots, invalid_request, others. Legacy responses may also include sold_out.

minParticipants.description: Minimum participants required for this slot; present even when unavailable.

maxParticipants.description: Maximum participants allowed for this slot.

language.description: ISO language code for localized content.

participants.description: Participant counts keyed by ticket category (age band), e.g. `adult`, `child`. Keys are lowercase and must match a `ticketCategory` returned by `GET /experiences/tours/{id}/availability` for this tour. An array (e.g. `[{"category":"adult","count":2}]`) is rejected, and uppercase keys (e.g. `ADULT`) are rejected - use the exact lowercase category strings from availability.

additionalProperties.description: Number of participants in this category.

addons.description: Optional add-ons to price alongside the tour, from `GET .../availability` `addons[].id`.

TourDealSummaryResponse.description: Present only when a promotional deal applies to the tour's from-price.

description.example: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts

cancellationFeeUnitOffsetMin.description: Minutes before start time the fee schedule above applies.

TourItineraryResponse.description: One day (or the only day) of a structured itinerary. Empty `itineraries` on the tour means the provider has no structured itinerary data.

TourBaseResponse.description: Shared tour fields returned by both search listings and the detail endpoint.

description.example: A guided morning tour with skip-the-line access.

TourSummaryResponse.description: Tour listing as returned by tour search. The list mapper collapses `notSuitableFor` to a single string. Use `GET /experiences/tours/{id}` for the full detail payload including `itineraries`.

notSuitableFor.description: First suitability restriction from the provider, collapsed to a single string by the list mapper.

TourDetailResponse.description: Full tour detail including structured itineraries.

notSuitableFor.description: Individual suitability restrictions from the provider.

itineraries.description: Ordered structured itinerary. Empty when the provider has no structured itinerary data.

independentlyBookable.description: Whether this category can be booked without an adult present.

share.description: Fraction of total reviews at this rating, 0-1.

comment.example: Our guide was fantastic and skip-the-line saved us hours.

BadRequest.description: Invalid discovery query, tour id or booking-options input. Code 71001.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed. Shared API-key middleware uses code 401; product handlers can use their operation-specific unauthorized code listed on the endpoint.

Forbidden.description: Access denied. Shared access middleware uses common codes; product-specific forbidden codes are listed on the endpoint.

error.message: user does not have enough permissions to perform this action
error.description: Experiences API access is not enabled for this account. Please contact support to get access

NotFound.description: Tour or requested discovery resource not found. Code 71002.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Booking-options request body exceeds the 1 MiB limit. Code 71001.

PrebookBadRequest.description: Invalid selection/input, selection rejected, or a price change requiring explicit client handling. Codes 72001, 72002 or 72004.

BookingConfirmBadRequest.description: Invalid booking input, expired hold, unconfirmed payment, mismatched transaction or a confirmed business rejection.

error.message: payment has not been confirmed yet; complete the Stripe payment before booking
error.description: payment has not been confirmed yet; complete the Stripe payment before booking

holdExpired.summary: Create a new prebook after the reservation hold expires

error.message: reservation hold has expired; please create a new prebook
error.description: reservation hold has expired; please create a new prebook

CancelBadRequest.description: Invalid booking id, already-cancelled booking, cancellation not allowed, or activity already started. A cancellation-not-allowed error does not necessarily mean non-refundable.

error.message: cancellation is not allowed for this booking
error.description: cancellation is not allowed for this booking

CancelPreviewBadRequest.description: Invalid booking id, already-cancelled booking, cancellation not allowed, or activity already started. A cancellation-not-allowed error does not necessarily mean non-refundable.

error.message: cancellation is not allowed for this booking
error.description: cancellation is not allowed for this booking

InternalServerError.description: Discovery operation failed. Code 71099. Shared middleware can return other common codes.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Experiences discovery is temporarily unavailable. Code 71007.

GatewayTimeout.description: Experiences discovery dependency timed out. Code 71004.

TooManyRequests.description: Shared Dispatcher request limit exceeded. Code 4290; this is not an Experiences operation code.

error.message: You have exceeded the allowed request limit
error.description: Too many requests, please try again later

details.reason: must match the selected slot net price from booking-options

get.description:
## Overview

Search available tours and activities with localized content and prices in your chosen currency. Supports free-text or geo search, plus filtering by date, language, price, category, rating, duration, and tour flags.

## When to Use

- **Search results** - Populate a tours listing or map view
- **Destination pages** - Show activities available in a city or region
- **Category browsing** - Filter tours by type, duration, or rating

## What You Get

- **Tour listings** - Titles, descriptions, images, and ratings
- **Localized content** - Names and descriptions in the requested language
- **Prices** - Amounts in the requested currency

## Quick Start

**Required:** `language`, `currency`

**Search (pick one):** `textSearch`, or `location[latitude]`/`location[longitude]`/`location[radiusKm]`

**Filters:** `dateRange[from]`/`dateRange[to]`, `languages`, `price[min]`/`price[max]`, `categories`, `rating[min]`/`rating[max]`, `duration[min]`/`duration[max]`, `flags`

**Sort:** `sort[field]`/`sort[direction]`

**Pagination:** `pagination[limit]`/`pagination[offset]`

Returns a paginated list of matching tours.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 71001 | invalid experience request |
| 71002 | experience not found |
| 71003 | experiences provider request failed |
| 71004 | experiences provider request timed out |
| 71005 | experience request is unauthorized |
| 71006 | experience request is forbidden |
| 71007 | experiences service is temporarily unavailable |
| 71099 | failed to retrieve experiences |

parameters.name: textSearch
parameters.description: Free-text search term (location name, tour title, etc). Mutually exclusive with `location[latitude]`/`location[longitude]`.

parameters.name: location[latitude]
parameters.description: Geo filter latitude. Must be sent together with `location[longitude]` and `location[radiusKm]`. Mutually exclusive with `textSearch`.

parameters.name: location[longitude]
parameters.description: Geo filter longitude. Must be sent together with `location[latitude]` and `location[radiusKm]`.

parameters.name: location[radiusKm]
parameters.description: Geo filter radius in kilometers around `location[latitude]`/`location[longitude]`.

parameters.name: dateRange[from]
parameters.description: Only return tours offered on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: dateRange[to]
parameters.description: Only return tours offered on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Filter to tours conducted in one or more of these ISO language codes (repeat the param per value, e.g. `languages=en&languages=fr`). Distinct from the required `language` param, which only controls localized content on the response.

parameters.name: price[min]
parameters.description: Minimum partner-facing selling price, in the requested `currency`. Bounds are interpreted using the same cent rounding as the returned price.

parameters.name: price[max]
parameters.description: Maximum partner-facing selling price, in the requested `currency`. Bounds are interpreted using the same cent rounding as the returned price.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Filter to one or more category ids (repeat the param per value, e.g. `categories=1&categories=2`). See the category `id`/`name` pairs returned on each tour.

parameters.name: rating[min]
parameters.description: Minimum overall tour rating (0-5).

parameters.name: rating[max]
parameters.description: Maximum overall tour rating (0-5).

parameters.name: duration[min]
parameters.description: Minimum tour duration in minutes.

parameters.name: duration[max]
parameters.description: Maximum tour duration in minutes.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Filter to tours matching one or more of these properties (repeat the param per value, e.g. `flags=wheelchair&flags=pick-up`).

parameters.name: sort[field]
parameters.description: Field to sort results by. `popularity` returns an internal recommended ranking and ignores `sort[direction]`.

parameters.name: sort[direction]
parameters.description: Sort direction. Ignored when `sort[field]=popularity`.

parameters.name: pagination[limit]
parameters.description: Maximum number of tours to return.

parameters.name: pagination[offset]
parameters.description: Number of tours to skip, for pagination.

## Overview

Retrieve full details for a specific tour, including description, media, inclusions, pricing context, and structured itineraries when available.

## When to Use

- **Product pages** - Display a tour detail view before the user selects dates
- **Comparison** - Show full metadata when comparing activities
- **Content enrichment** - Fetch descriptions and images for marketing surfaces

## What You Get

- **Complete tour profile** - Title, description, duration, and highlights
- **Media** - Images and cover assets
- **Practical info** - Meeting points, cancellation policy, and inclusions
- **Structured itineraries** - Ordered days/items (`itineraries`) when the provider supplies them. `locations` are importance-ordered tags, not itinerary order.
- **Localized pricing** - Prices in the requested currency

## Quick Start

Provide the tour `id` in the URL path plus required `language` and `currency` query parameters.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 71001 | invalid experience request |
| 71002 | experience not found |
| 71003 | experiences provider request failed |
| 71004 | experiences provider request timed out |
| 71005 | experience request is unauthorized |
| 71006 | experience request is forbidden |
| 71007 | experiences service is temporarily unavailable |
| 71099 | failed to retrieve experiences |

## Overview

Retrieve available dates and time slots for a specific tour so users can pick when to attend.

## When to Use

- **Date pickers** - Populate a calendar or slot selector on the tour page
- **Availability checks** - Confirm a tour runs on the user's travel dates
- **Booking flow** - Gate the checkout path until a valid slot is selected

## What You Get

- **Available dates** - Days the tour can be booked
- **Time slots** - Start times per date where applicable
- **Capacity hints** - Whether slots are still bookable

## Quick Start

Provide the tour `id` in the URL path and the required `language` query parameter.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 71001 | invalid experience request |
| 71002 | experience not found |
| 71003 | experiences provider request failed |
| 71004 | experiences provider request timed out |
| 71005 | experience request is unauthorized |
| 71006 | experience request is forbidden |
| 71007 | experiences service is temporarily unavailable |
| 71099 | failed to retrieve experiences |

## Overview

Retrieve normalized guest reviews and ratings for a specific tour.

## When to Use

- **Review sections** - Display guest feedback on tour detail pages
- **Trust building** - Show authentic ratings before booking
- **Decision support** - Help users evaluate tours before selecting dates

## What You Get

- **Guest reviews** - Review text, ratings, and dates
- **Pagination** - `limit` and `offset` query parameters
- **Sorting** - `sortBy` (`date` or `rating`) with `sortDirection`
- **Localized content** - Reviews in the requested language where available

## Quick Start

Provide the tour `id` in the URL path plus required `language` and `currency` query parameters. Optionally page through results with `limit`/`offset`, and sort with `sortBy`/`sortDirection`.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 71001 | invalid experience request |
| 71002 | experience not found |
| 71003 | experiences provider request failed |
| 71004 | experiences provider request timed out |
| 71005 | experience request is unauthorized |
| 71006 | experience request is forbidden |
| 71007 | experiences service is temporarily unavailable |
| 71099 | failed to retrieve experiences |

post.description:
## Overview

Resolve priced booking options, time slots, and required guest inputs for a selected tour date and participant mix.

## When to Use

- **Option/slot pickers** - Show available variants and start times for a date
- **Live pricing** - Display slot totals (`pricing.totals.net` / `priceSummary.netPrice`)
- **Checkout forms** - Collect `bookingQuestionSchema` before proceeding to payment

## What You Get

- **Booking options** - `optionId`, title, and `bookingQuestionSchema`
- **Time slots** - `dateTime`, `isAvailable`, and slot-level pricing (`unitNet` / `totalNet` / `totals.net` / `priceSummary.netPrice`, plus `totals.commission`)
- **Participant mapping** - Uses `ticketCategory` keys from availability (e.g. `adult`, `child`)

## Quick Start

POST a body with `language`, `currency`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), and `participants` to `/experiences/tours/{id}/booking-options`. Use slot `pricing.totals.net` as `selection.price.amount` on prebook, and for checkout handoff.

## Option-level `price`

`options[].price.amount` reflects the lowest available slot price for the requested mix. Checkout uses the chosen slot's `pricing.totals.net`.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 71001 | invalid experience request |
| 71002 | experience not found |
| 71003 | experiences provider request failed |
| 71004 | experiences provider request timed out |
| 71005 | experience request is unauthorized |
| 71006 | experience request is forbidden |
| 71007 | experiences service is temporarily unavailable |
| 71099 | failed to retrieve experiences |

## Overview

Create a temporary hold on the selected tour slot and a Stripe PaymentIntent for checkout.

## When to Use

- **Checkout start** — After the user picks option, slot, and participants from booking-options
- **Payment setup** — Obtain `transactionId` and `secretKey` for Stripe SDK confirmation
- **Hold window** — Reserve inventory for ~10 minutes before book

## What You Get

- **Checkout context** — `tourId`, `optionId`, `dateTime`, `language`, `participants`, and pricing echoed back
- **Provider refs** — `cartId`, `experienceBookingId`, `providerBookingId`, `status`, `reservationExpiresAt`
- **Stripe fields** — `transactionId`, `secretKey`, `paymentTypes: ["TRANSACTION_ID"]`

## Quick Start

POST the same `selection` used for display pricing from booking-options with `usePaymentSdk: true`. Confirm payment with Stripe, then call `POST /experiences/bookings`.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 72001 | selection price mismatch |
| 72002 | invalid experience selection |
| 72003 | prebook resource not found |
| 72004 | experience selection rejected by provider |
| 72005 | experience prebook conflicts with the current state |
| 72006 | prebook provider request failed |
| 72007 | prebook provider request timed out |
| 72008 | prebook request is unauthorized |
| 72009 | prebook request is forbidden |
| 72010 | prebook service is temporarily unavailable |
| 72011 | booking currency is not accepted for this selection |
| 72099 | failed to create prebook |

For 72001, requested/expected are customer SELL totals; do not apply markup or FX again. Inspect the code on HTTP 400, 409 and 422. A generic no-money error must not open price-change consent.

200.description: Prebook created with selection context, validate refs, and Stripe checkout fields

404.description: Requested prebook resource not found. Code 72003.

409.description: State conflict or price-change validation. Inspect error.code.

error.message: experience prebook conflicts with the current state
error.description: experience prebook conflicts with the current state

413.description: Request body exceeds the 1 MiB limit. Code 72002.

422.description: Selection validation failed. The numeric code and detail structure are the same as for HTTP 400.

502.description: Prebook dependency failed or returned unusable monetary information. Code 72006; no price details are returned in the safe fallback.

post.description:
## Overview

Confirm the booking after the guest completes payment, using the `prebookId` and `transactionId` from the prebook step.

## When to Use

- **Final booking step** - After the guest confirms payment via the Stripe SDK using the prebook's `secretKey`

## What You Get

- **`status`** - `PENDING_CONFIRMATION` right away; final `CONFIRMED` status arrives via webhook
- **`price`** / **`commission`** / **`clientCommission`** - Your price and earnings for this booking

## Quick Start

POST with `prebookId`, `billing`, `traveler`, and `payment.method: TRANSACTION_ID`. An `ERROR` status on the underlying cart returns HTTP 502.

## Error codes

## Overview

Retrieve the current state of an experience booking by its booking ID, including status, pricing, and voucher details once available.

## When to Use

- **Poll for confirmation** - Check whether a booking has moved from `PENDING_CONFIRMATION` to `CONFIRMED`
- **Booking details page** - Display status, price, and voucher to the guest
- **Support queries** - Look up a booking's current state

## What You Get

- **`status`** - Current booking status (`PENDING_CONFIRMATION`, `CONFIRMED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED`)
- **`voucher`** - Ticket/reference details, once available
- **`price`** / **`commission`** / **`clientCommission`** - Your price and earnings for this booking
- **Cancellation details** - `refund`, `cancellationRequestedAt`, `cancelledAt`, `refundProcessedAt`, when applicable

## Quick Start

GET with the `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. Poll until `status` is `CONFIRMED` (or use webhooks), or retrieve the voucher once available.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 74001 | booking not found |
| 74002 | invalid booking retrieval request |
| 74003 | booking retrieval request is unauthorized |
| 74099 | failed to retrieve booking |

## Overview

Preview the refund amount and cancellation fee for a booking before committing to cancel it.

## When to Use

- **Cancellation confirmation screens** - Show the guest exactly what they'll be refunded
- **Support tooling** - Check whether a booking is still cancellable before offering a refund

## What You Get

- **`cancellable`** - Whether the booking can currently be cancelled
- **`policy`** - `cancellationFee`, `refundAmount`, `refundType`, `estimateConfidence`, `currency`, `sellingPrice`

## Quick Start

GET this endpoint with the `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. This does not cancel the booking - call `POST /experiences/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel` to actually cancel.

## Overview

Cancel a confirmed experience booking and trigger any applicable refund.

## When to Use

- **Guest-initiated cancellation** - After the guest confirms via the cancel-preview screen

## What You Get

- **`status`** - Booking status after cancellation
- **`providerStatus`** - Raw upstream provider status, when available
- **`refund`** - Present when a refund was calculated; `refundPending` indicates it hasn't settled yet

## Quick Start
